domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and the web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) for all queries, so no domestic-supply record was located. Company website agrocrops.com describes operations only in general terms ("we handle 150,000 tons of produce every year", "Our Chennai peanut factory where we perform R&D", "Agrocrops Commissions Advanced Dry Chilli Processing Facility in Guntur (India)") — these are self-declarations of capacity/facilities, not evidence of a specific domestic supply transaction, so they are recorded as declared, not confirmed.
note: Export side is solidly confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records out of Mundra Sea to Vietnam, Singapore, Philippines, UAE and Vietnam, with HS 12024210 (groundnut kernels, shelled, not roasted) matching the declared HS 120242 — the declared code is correct at 6-digit level, the records carry the 8-digit 12024210. Note the company also ships adjacent products under other codes (12074090 sesame, 15081000 crude groundnut oil), so it is a multi-commodity agri trader/exporter rather than a single-HS supplier. Role: appears to be manufacturer_trader (own BRC-certified Chennai peanut plant plus trading of sesame and groundnut oil), though the plant claim rests on the company's own site only. Domestic Indian supply: no verifiable record found — registries blocked (403) and search engine down, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found; absence here reflects tool failure, not proven absence of domestic sales. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives only a record count (196), no values, and no financials were publicly retrievable. No CIN/PAN confirmed (zaubacorp blocked), so those remain null.
